why: The criterion holds. I read the problem field and all seven expect lines. The problem field only says what is wrong: none of the exports "pads a value to a fixed width", and the README "is already incomplete" because slugify has no section. It proposes no fix. No expect line names a technique (padStart, a loop and so on), an internal helper, or an internal return value. They check observable results only: that padLeft is exported, that padLeft(42, 5, '0') gives '00042', that longer input comes back unchanged, that the existing functions still work, that a test exists and `npm test` passes, and that the README has a section for every function. The request itself requires the name padLeft, the zero padding and a complete README. The choices it leaves open are recorded under assumptions: the (s, n, ch) signature, converting numbers to strings, not cutting long input, and the default pad character.
